title: Existence of the abelian Čech augmentation quotient in one degree
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\iota$ a type, $U_i$ any family of open subsets of $X$, $F$ an abelian sheaf [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], and $q\in\mathbb N$. Suppose that for every injective resolution $I$ of $F$, the map $\alpha_I$ of [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction] is a quasi-isomorphism. There exists an additive map $c:\check H^q(U,F)\to H^q(X,F)$ satisfying IsAbelianCechComparison on every injective resolution, with the predicate defined in [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction]. This assertion has no normalization conclusion and does not require that the opens cover $X$.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, construction of H(beta) H(alpha) inverse and independence of the resolution

proof.text: Fix an injective resolution I. The constant integer sheaf adjunction evaluated at 1 identifies its Hom complex with the global section complex, including the differentials. Pass to cocycles modulo coboundaries and use InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass to get an additive isomorphism e from Ext to section-complex homology. Its cocycle formula is extEquivCohomologyClass_extMk; monicity of iCycles identifies the specified cycle z uniquely.

Define c as homologyMap(beta), inverse homologyMap(alpha), and inverse e. The supplied quasi-isomorphism hypothesis ensures that homologyMap(alpha) is invertible. The cocycle formula for e proves the quotient equation on I.

For another resolution J lift the identity of F to I -> J. Naturality of restrictions and the augmentation identity give commuting alpha and beta squares. InjectiveResolution.extMk_comp_mk₀ with the identity gives compatibility of e with the section homology map, so that map is invertible. The alpha square then makes the total homology map invertible. Transport the equation on I and cancel the total map to get the equation on J for all x, a, ha and z. No cover assumption or finiteness enters this argument.

theorem exists_abelianCechComparison_core
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (hα : ∀ I : InjectiveResolution F, QuasiIso (abelianCechAlpha U I)) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : (TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyFunctor U q).obj F ⟶
      (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) q).obj F,
      IsAbelianCechComparison U F q c
